hooksPath_correction.what_D9_claimed: core.hooksPath points at a deleted worktree so the pre-commit eval gate is silently disarmed REPO-WIDE.
hooksPath_correction.what_was_actually_true: The scope claim was wrong. .git/config's local value has always been the correct .githooks; three worktrees each carried a config.worktree override pointing at a deleted agent worktree, and `git config <key>` prints the effective value with no hint of which scope supplied it. Only those three worktrees were disarmed; every other checkout gated normally throughout. The orchestrator unset all three overrides and the hook now fires.
hooksPath_correction.fix: The Debt row is struck and closed, rewritten to state the real cause and scope, and the --no-verify explanation is dropped with the condition that forced it. The lesson kept in the row: `git config --show-origin --get-all core.hooksPath` would have shown this in one line and D9 did not run it before writing 'repo-wide' into the ledger.
